subject.title: [Proposal] Simplify Model Configuration: Single-Source Reconcile + Session Override Reset

question: Should OpenClaw add an official model/session reconcile-reset surface, and if so should it only report by default or also clear explicit session, agent, and auth pins under scoped flags?
rationale: The requested behavior changes persisted session state, explicit user model/auth selections, agent-level overrides, generated model catalog state, and provider routing semantics, which source inspection cannot safely decide without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
options.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Leave runtime precedence unchanged and improve status, doctor, and config validation warnings for shadowed or invalid model refs.

options.title: Automatic precedence change
options.body: Make default-model changes or resets automatically clear or override existing pins, accepting a compatibility break for durable session or agent selections.

recommendation.title: Dry-run plus opt-in reset
recommendation.body: Add `models reconcile` and/or `sessions model-reset` as report-first commands that preserve explicit pins by default and require scoped flags to clear them.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed history across the inspected model CLI, session override, status, and docs surfaces.
